correctness.rationale: A finite-field quadratic character sum reduces exactly to the radical K_B of X -> BX+XB. For odd characteristic, 2Q_B(H)=0 on K_B gives support A in the self-adjoint image, and the determinant/trace strata have dimensions 0,2,3,4. Characteristic two reduces K_B to the matrix centralizer, and the canonical trace identity psi(cu^2)=psi(c^(q/2)u) yields two independent affine constraints for nonscalar B. Stratum counts reproduce every stated magnitude multiplicity. The bundled exact checker exhaustively verified all frequencies at q=2 and q=3 and samples over q=4,5,9, including nonprime fields; finite checks are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The canonical noncommutative matrix-square graph is natural; the exact full frequency-zero classification and every convolution singular-value multiplicity constitute a complete spectral invariant over all finite fields. The limiting support fraction changes from one in odd characteristic to zero at order q^-2 in characteristic two, a structural and nontrivial arithmetic boundary invisible in nondegenerate scalar paraboloids. Classification covers all field sizes rather than a narrow table.
